title: KryProbe kcrypto lifecycle payload v1
description: Standalone report-JSON profile for one reduced kcrypto request lifecycle (schema kryprobe.kcrypto.lifecycle/v1). NOT carried in the v0 event envelope: event-v0 has no backend_payload property and forbids additional properties, so envelope carriage is deferred to a versioned envelope ADR (frozen v0 bytes are untouched). Draft: bytes freeze only after review (no compiled-in pin yet). Structural validation never establishes evidence truth; see docs/kcrypto-evidence.md.

status.description: Exact native errno from the terminal edge (JSON integer, i32 range; zero-fraction numbers admitted per JSON Schema). Null if and only if terminal is unknown.

duration_ns.description: Submit-to-terminal-edge span as a canonical decimal u64 string (0..=18446744073709551615; the validator enforces the exact range). Null when either endpoint is missing; never zero-filled for unknown terminals.

allOf.description: Terminal truth requires an exact native status; unknown terminals carry no status or duration.
